home.description: A team workspace built with NestJS and Nestvexa: Live task board, realtime dashboard, multi-step forms, uploads, Vue Inertia analytics and islands.
home.lead: A small team workspace built with NestJS and Nestvexa. Everything here runs in one Nest application with seeded, fictional data.

features.dashboard: A dashboard whose metrics update in realtime, next to React, Vue and Svelte islands.
features.board: A Live task board: search, filters, sorting, pages, a modal editor and file attachments.
features.profile: A three-step profile setup with server validation, drafts and a path that works without JavaScript.
features.insights: A Vue Inertia analytics section with server rendering and deferred data.
features.mail: Email notifications rendered with the same view engine (test transport).
